audit.whatIsWrong: The three interactions that actually decide this matchup are all absent. Meditate is a channel — any CC cancels it, and Rupture's knockup is exactly that. Alpha Strike makes Master Yi untargetable for its duration, which throws away a Feast opened into it. Highlander makes him immune to all slowing effects, so Rupture's slow and Vorpal Spikes' slow both read zero while it is up. The page also lumps his damage together as 'Q-E-W true damage'; only Wuju Style (E) deals true damage.
audit.why: Each of these changes a button press. Cancelling Meditate is the single highest-value thing a Cho'Gath does in this lane and the page never mentions the ability exists. Feast is an 80-second point-blank ultimate, and Alpha Strike's untargetable window is the standard way it gets thrown away. And a Cho'Gath who believes his slows will kite a Highlander Yi is about to find out otherwise — the knockup still works, the slows do not.
audit.corrected: Name Meditate as an interruptible 10s channel, Alpha Strike's untargetable window against Feast, Wuju Style as the true-damage source at 14s, and Highlander's 85s slow immunity.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' and it is correct — the content layer contains no cooldown numbers at all, and there is no full-layer entry for this matchup to carry them instead.
audit.why: Meditate is 10s flat. Wuju Style is 14s flat. Alpha Strike is 20s at rank 1, but basic attacks shorten it, so it comes back faster in an extended fight than the number suggests. Highlander is 85s flat and its cooldown drops further on kills and assists. Those are the four timers worth counting.
audit.corrected: Put 10s, 14s, 20s and 85s into the early/mid/late paragraphs and the whys.

audit.why: The content win array reads Cho'Gath, Cho'Gath, Skill, Master Yi, Master Yi, Master Yi, Cho'Gath and matches the packet chart on all seven rows, the whys on all seven rows, and the 52.6% headline over 192 games. This is the only matchup in my slice whose chart needed nothing.

audit.why: Meditate restores health on a 10s cooldown, which is what the missing-interactions file flags for this lane, so Grievous Wounds has real value — but the stronger answer is simply cancelling the channel, which costs nothing.
